hypothesis: Omitting four unused component averages reduces aggregate work while retaining table metrics.

variants.A: Current working tree: selected chart controls component averages
variants.B: Same snapshot: always calculate component averages

presentation: Report improvement is B (before) to A (current). A is the optimized working-tree baseline.

scope.period: All stored dates in a frozen snapshot; unknown dates included for every grouping.
scope.timing: Public DB page API, including SQL preparation, execution and first-page materialization; warm rollups and cache.
scope.control: averageTokens SQL is identical; tokens also represents requests and averageDuration SQL.
scope.addition: One normalized request through replaceMemory, including active rollup update and COMMIT; source parsing excluded.
scope.privacy: Only hashes, counts, timings and SQL plans are exported; snapshot contents stay in ignored cache.
